spans.s: युधिष्ठिर-पुरोगम, adj. having Yudhiṣṭhira as leader, led on by Yudhiṣṭhira.
1. युध् युध् (akin to 1. यु), i. 4, Ātm. (also Par.,

).
 1. To fight, to contend in battle,

; impersonal pass., Hit. iii. d. 88.
 2. To oppose, Johns.

. युद्ध, n.
 1. The use of arms,

. War, battle, Pañc. 87, 15.
 --Comp.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. अ-योध्य,
 I. adj., f. या, not to be warred against,

.
 II. f. या, the capital of Rāma, the modern Oude,
, sqq. Desider. युयुत्स, To desire to fight,

; Hit. iii. d. 50.
 --With the prep. आ आ, To oppose,

. The same, 3, 15054.
 2. To fight with, Utt.

.
 --With प्रा प्र-आ, To fight, Śiś. 18, 32.
 --With नि नि, नियुद्ध, n. Fighting, particularly boxing,

.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रयुद्ध, n. War, battle. Desider. To desire to fight,

.
 --Caus. The same, 1, 7116.
 --With सम् सम्. The same, 1, 3477 [] Caus. The same, 1, 7098.
 --Cf. ὑσμίνη, ὑσμίν (cf. युध्म).

2. युध् युध्,
 I. f. War, battle, Pañc. iii. d. 11.
 II. m. A warrior, Johns.
युधान (ptcple. pres. of युध्, ii. 2), m. An enemy.
युध् + इ-श्रेष्ठ, adj. Preeminent in battle,
युधिष्ठिर, i. e. युध् + इ-स्थिर, m. The elder of the five Pāṇḍavas, Pañc. ii. d. 4.

युध् + म, m.
 1. War, battle.
 2. A bow.
 3. An arrow.
 4. A warrior.

i. e. -युध् + वन् in सह-,
 I. adj. Fighting with, or along with.
 II. m. A brother in arms.
